researchConclusion: Bounded public checks did not yield usable distinct dealer artwork. Generic text banners or unavailable image-host URLs do not prove that the dealer has no logo. This artwork is clearly an independent proposal.

generation.prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Produce one professional dealer-logo asset on a truly transparent background. Wide horizontal lockup with a separate compact emblem at left, generous transparent gap, and the exact business name at right in bold custom geometric lettering. The emblem must stay clear at 32px, thick strokes and few shapes. Flat crisp vector-like artwork; no gradients, no shadows, no mockup, no photography, no extra text. Every dark element must have a fine white outer keyline and every white element a dark navy outline, so this identical master works on white, charcoal #111113 and dark red #c40101. Use a clean solid silhouette, not decorative outlines. This is an independent proposal, not dealer-approved artwork. Exact name: B&S CARS. Left emblem an original interlocked B and S compact monogram, ampersand only in the adjacent wordmark. Bold rounded square proportions, forest green #24745a and navy. Wordmark B&S large with CARS below. No badges, no car silhouette, no fine details.

surfaceReview.method: Exact pipeline alpha-padding crop and resize of actual generated surface artwork. Separate light-ink generated wordmark is used on dark and accent surfaces. Compact inputs are documented actual imagegen outputs or isolated lossless crops.
surfaceReview.review: Visually reviewed the exact pipeline cropTransparentPadding exports at 120 px and 180 px wordmark widths and 32 px and 64 px compact sizes against all six required background colours. Spelling and transparency checked. Filled light wordmarks improve contrast on dark surfaces; artwork colours do not change template palettes.

additionalGenerations.prompt: Use case: logo-brand, mandatory colour correction to the provided B&S CARS identity. Preserve the exact B/S monogram, all letterforms, arrangement and business spelling. Change EVERY dark navy filled region in both emblem and wordmark to SOLID WHITE #ffffff. The exact right-hand text B&S and CARS must BOTH be filled white, not navy, not green, not outlines. Keep the dark forest-green S segment inside the left compact monogram only. A thin dark contour around the white letters is allowed. This asset is for a BLACK or RED background, but DO NOT draw any background: output real TRANSPARENCY. Entire right-hand typography must visibly be white in the output. No new shapes, no text changes, no new font, no shading, no gradients, no speckles, perfectly clean edges. The original navy artwork is rejected for this dark-surface role.
